The status vector encodes binary validity indicators for each sitemap, enabling probabilistic inference on site completeness. The taxonomy tree models hierarchical URL structures, allowing for efficient path resolution and content categorization. These primitives form a dual framework: one for validating site structure (GSI), another for navigating it (GSE). Failure modes include 404s which break connectivity in G and reduce entropy in v_s, while empty U in T implies structural collapse. Dualities emerge between graph traversal and tree decomposition, both encoding semantic relationships among URIs.
